text:
Anya: Heads-up — seeing a small but reproducible perplexity drift on the Mixtral canary after the kernel-selection heuristic change. Canary = mixtral-8x7b@32k. trace: https://internal/perf/trace/2623456789 :eyes:
Mike: How big of a drift? model-only or a bunch of routes?
Anya: Small but consistent. baseline ppl=12.4 -> canary ppl=13.3 on our longctx eval set (32k). Token divergence starts ~6k tokens in. Not seeing similar on Llama runs so far.
Mike: OK can you paste the perf summary?
perf-bot: automated profile summary attached:
```
PROFILE SUMMARY (canary vs baseline)
- kernel_picker: increased fallback to stable-kernel-v2 (fast-kernel-v3 used 72% -> 38%)
- memcopies: +24% (kv load path)
- kv-cache hit-rate: 98.7% baseline -> 97.1% canary (small but correlates)
- batcher: avg batch tokens +18% (more cross-batch padding)
- latency p50 +2ms, p95 +9ms
- notable: increased "rotary-scale" path selects yarn-variant in some longctx shards
```
Cheng: My first guess: RoPE scaling variant selection is flipping to a YARN-ish blend for certain head groups when kernel picker changes thresholds. YARN vs NTK differences can cause phase offsets when head_kv_dim != rotary_dim. Can we force rope_variant=ntk-linear on the canary? @Anya
Lina: Also double-check batcher heuristics — the new heuristic increased target_seq_len for longctx, which increases cross-request padding and may expose a kv eviction timing issue. If batcher holds more tokens, the kv slot churn pattern changes.
Sam: Quick repro config I ran locally that reduced the regression:
```yaml
runtime.optimizations:
  rope_variant: "ntk-linear"   # force ntk scaling
  head_kv_override: 64          # align head-kv dims to rotary
batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 65536      # lower than canary default 98304
  dynamic_target: true
```
Anya: Ran that patch on the canary subset. New eval ppl=12.47, latency p50 +3ms (acceptable). The token divergence disappears in the previous failure traces.
Mike: Nice. Can we add a focused regression test to nightly eval (longctx 32k mixtral) gating on rope_variant + head_kv dims? If this recurs we'll catch it before canary.
Cheng: I suspect root cause is a corner in the kernel picker: when selected kernel changes, we sometimes recompute rotary scaling per-kv-head using a head-count heuristic that assumed head_kv_dim == rotary_dim. Add an assert and safe-fallback (force ntk-linear if mismatch) helps avoid the phase misapply. I'll open a PR.
Lina: Also let's instrument kv-slot lifetime distribution (histogram) in the runtime so we can correlate batcher token padding vs eviction jitter.
Sam: I'll own the nightly eval addition (test id: longctx-mixtral-rope-2623) and add the config permutations matrix (rope_variant x head_kv_dim x batcher.max_batch_tokens).
Anya: Action items:
- Cheng: PR with assert + safe-fallback in kernel picker (priority)
- Sam: nightly test + perm matrix
- Lina: kv-slot lifetime histogram metric + dashboard panel
- Me: run expanded canary (10% traffic) with ntk-linear override until fix lands
If the PR doesn't land in 24h we'll rollback the kernel-selection tweak on canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Mike: Please paste the PR link when ready and mark the canary run in the incident log if we rollback.
perf-bot: scheduled collection: longctx-canary-2623456789 -> archived at /artifacts/longctx/2623456789.zip
Anya: Updated the canary tag and added trace links to the ticket. Will follow up with numbers after Cheng's PR lands. :shipit:
